# Keymap Diagrams

This directory contains automatically generated keyboard layout diagrams.

## Auto-generated Files

- `*.svg` - Keyboard layout diagrams in SVG format
- `*.yaml` - YAML format keyboard layout definitions used by keymap-drawer

## How to Update

When you modify keymap files in the `config/` directory, GitHub Actions will automatically regenerate these diagrams.

You can also manually trigger regeneration in the GitHub Actions page.
